title: Very thin for the price
text:
Very thin for the price. The quality of the product is great, but whomever takes photographs for their sales team does a good job because this is thin and flat.. no where near as thick as the picture looks. Im not returning it.. was sleeping on the floor after my air mattress went flat.. but they should really double the thickness of the padding they use.

It came with a nice matching cover and storage bag.. its fairly nice... just for the price it's a bit too flat to make it worth the cost. It's like laying on an over sized yoga mat.

Editing to add that after sleeping on it a few nights it's rather comfortable
